title: CWP/33286/2025 of MOHAN LAL BALWARIA Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND ORS
text:
= IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Sr. No.132 CWP-33286-2025 Date of decision : 11.11.2025 Mohan Lal Balwaria Petitioner Versus StateofHaryanaandothers Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPAK SIBAL HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE LAPITA BANERJI Present : Mr. Anil Kumar Sharma, Advocate, for the petitioner. Mr. Saurabh Mago, DAG, Haryana. 2 ok ok ok Ok DEEPAK SIBAL, J. (Oral)

1. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that at this stage, he would be satisfied if the present writ petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent No.2Deputy Commissioner, Rewari to take a decision on the representation dated 13.10.2025 (Annexure P-13) submitted by the petitioner.

2. Learned State counsel, who appears on advance notice, has no objection if the above prayer is accepted.

3. Accordingly, at this stage, without commenting on the merits of the case, the writ petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent No.4 to consider the representation dated 13.10.2025 (Annexure P-13) and if a favourable recommendation is made by respondent No.4 then the same shall be considered by respondent No.2 and decision thereupon be taken, by passing a speaking order and after affording opportunity of hearing to all affected parties, preferably within one month from the date of receipt of a copy of such recommendation from respondent No.4.

4. Needless to add that the decision so taken be communicated to the petitioner and if the decision is not to the satisfaction of the petitioner, he would be at liberty to challenge the same, in accordance with law. [DEEPAK SIBAL] JUDGE 11.11.2025 [LAPITA BANERJ]] Kapil JUDGE KAPIL
